scripts.package:win: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node20-win-x64 --output dist/wxreport-win.exe
scripts.package:mac: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node20-macos-x64 --output dist/wxreport-mac
